original_text: Agello (93122b647a) puts LiteRT-LM caches under Library/Caches/com.patricedery.agello.litertlm: with a runtime that reports no build id (Google's v0.18.0 binary) one folder per context size, kv-<maxNumTokens>, keeping the two most recently used; with a build that reports one (ours, litert_lm_get_build_info) a single folder kv-all-<build id> for every size; the embedder uses embedding or embedding-<build id>; and the benchmark engine passes the cache directory ":nocache".

text: The main LLM executor requests Metal argument buffers too: its CreateCompilationOptions (runtime/executor/llm_executor_settings_utils.cc) calls SetCommonGpuOptions on the GPU compilation options, and SetCommonGpuOptions calls SetUseMetalArgumentBuffers(true) under #if defined(__APPLE__); the release Agello ships has the same code. Google's commit 172d6806 (2026-09-09) removed only the separate direct call from CreateCompilationOptions.
